FilmmakerEditorDesignerPhotography

My films often begin with a sound, a feeling or an atmosphere rather than a story. I'm drawn to silences, small gestures and overlooked details. A Film and Video Design student at MIT Institute of Design, Pune, with roots in English Literature and motion graphics, I'm now an Assistant Director in Malayalam cinema, chasing films that linger after they end.
